verdict.rationale: Sentry's source is publicly readable. It has a public GitHub repository, users describe reading the code directly, and long-time self-hosters install it via git clone. However, the community reports that Sentry was relicensed to the Business Source License, which at least one user treats as closed-source rather than an open license. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the current license terms, and evidence that the license is a genuinely open (OSI-approved) license rather than BSL source-available.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Sentry is the debugging platform that helps every developer detect, trace, and fix issues.
they could read exactly what the code does instead of relying on docs
